actual_file_scope: Entire final theorem, full restriction/transport/count/generator proof and concrete-scope remark freshly read. Final AL.6 simple-simeq typography observed.
checks: The exact nonsplit wreath transport compares lifts modulo N with stabilizer lifts modulo inner S; no splitting of the outer extension is used. Distinct coordinates of a surjective crown quotient give distinct N-conjugacy classes.

H0 is the fixed inverse image of B0/S, normal of index a at most b0, and corresponds to an arbitrary degree at punctured cover. The new ordinary hereditary theorem therefore applies without any ramification condition.
Each ambient GL conjugacy orbit contains at most |GL| actual S-conjugacy classes of B0-valued restrictions. No ambient normalizer assumption is made.
After normalizing by an actual S conjugation, each of the a-1 nonidentity cosets has exactly one prescribed S-coset of possible images, giving the safe |S|^(a-1) extension upper bound.
The exponent conversion using r² log q at most kappa log|S| and a at most b0 is valid for every t at least1; the stated c_R absorbs the integer rounding.
The exact LMT threshold retains d(P). The inequality 2t log2|S| at most |S|^t for |S| at least60 supplies the advertised c_R+2 generator bound.

Pure permutation S^t semidirect P is monolithic primitive: transitivity makes the socle minimal normal, its centralizer is trivial, and a maximal subgroup missing the non-Frattini nonabelian socle is core-free.

The defining-p SL_(p^u) example has trivial scalar centre and the previously audited natural matrix/order comparison; nonsimple parameters are expressly excluded. No uniform d(P), projective/semilinear or full-FG assertion is made.
